notes.title: Vote on Dungeon Arsenal for the 'Sit Back and Relax' Category!
notes.notes:
The primordial concept when creating Dungeon Arsenal was for it to be a game that you could play when you were tired of playing longer games - literally to be a filler.

You sit back, choose your Hero and enter the dungeon. The procedural generation of the floors, items, relics, monsters and the fast-paced rhythm makes you experience a complete different adventure every time you start a new game.

If you think Dungeon Arsenal really fits this concept, please consider voting for it on the "Sit Back and Relax" category on the 2021 Steam Awards.

Thank you very much for the support on this journey and stay tuned for new updates!

notes.title: Update: version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]1.0.3 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Fixes and Balance[/b]
[olist]
[*] The “Omamori” relic cost was reduced.
[*] The “Tower Scheme” cost was reduced.
[/olist]
[b]New[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added a button in the Shops to refresh the Relic (works once per Shop visit).
[*] Added three new Relics:
[b]Magical Hat: [/b]Whenever you discard a “Wooden Staff”, heal 1 extra HP.
[b]Framed Heart: [/b]Every time you fill up the Special Gauge, heal 2 HP.
[b]Thorn Shield:[/b] Whenever an enemy misses an attack it takes 1 damage.
[*] Bosses now have effects! Fight them to see what they are capable of now!
[/olist]
[b]Misc[/b]
[olist]
[*] The item “Blade Oil” will no longer appear on Chests.
[*] The “Thief’s Belt” relic is now exclusive to the Rogue and its effect was updated to: Floor Start: if you have no cards in hand create a 'Dagger' Card in hand. If your hand is full, heal 1 HP.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update: version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.2 ends the Halloween event.

[b]1.0.2 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Fixes and Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug on the item card “Key” which allowed it to be used even with 0 AP.
[*] Now the "Blade Oil" item card will give +1 ATK to all Axes variants.
[*] The requirements for some Steam Achievements were adjusted.
[*] The requirements to unlock some heroes were adjusted.
[*] The requirements to unlock some hero’s card borders were adjusted.[/list]
[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*] A new difficulty mode was added: “Insane”.
[*] Two new Steam Achievements were added, both related to the new difficulty mode.
[*] Now some stats of your run will be displayed on the game over screen and when you finish the game.[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] A few spider webs from the Halloween event will stay where they are, for now.[/list]

notes.notes: Come join the developer playing the game during the next Steam festival!

notes.title: Beta Testing: The Final Days
notes.notes:
The feedback from the community in the Beta phase was amazing and helped the game to become what it is today. If you participated in this phase, whether by playing, adding the game to the wish list, retweeting our posts or any other kind of interation, [b]thank you very much[/b].

Dungeon Arsenal is almost ready to be released, and while we focus on final tweaking until the release date (10/20/2021) we will discontinue access to the game's beta version on 10/10/2021. If you have a beta key you will be able to play the game in its latest beta version (1.0.8) but after that date, the beta version of the game will be removed from Steam.

Thanks to the entire indie gaming community for supporting us on this journey!
